subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity mode use the nearest actionable reset for menu-bar display while highest-usage ranking uses maximum consumption, or should both consumers expose the same most-constrained quota lane?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally coherent, but they produce visibly different percentages for the same snapshot and the existing repository does not establish which semantic contract maintainers want.

options.title: Approve consumer-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-consumption highest-usage ranking, with direct runtime proof documenting the intentional difference.

options.title: Use one constrained lane
options.body: Resolve one most-constrained Antigravity quota window and use it consistently for both ranking and displayed menu-bar values.

options.title: Narrow the fix
options.body: Only retain exhausted supported-cadence buckets in the existing selection model and defer reset-aware selection to a separately reviewed product change.

recommendation.title: Approve consumer-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-consumption highest-usage ranking, with direct runtime proof documenting the intentional difference.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the contributor's explicit request make this the strongest available owner for the user-visible automatic-selection contract.
